classification.difficultyReason: Construct successive translated images, then combine horizontal and vertical shifts, accounting for cancellation of opposite directions.

content.prompt: In each part perform the two transformations successively. Then find a single translation that has the same effect.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Translate 1 right, 2 up, then 3 right, 1 up.

spec.description: Seven-column, five-row grid with red A one square right and one square up from the bottom-left corner.
spec.mathematics: A is at local grid position (1,1); coordinates are not printed.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the original point is visible.

answer.worked:
Move $A$ 1 square right and 2 squares up to $A'$. Move $A'$ 3 squares right and 1 square up to $A''$.

Horizontal shift: $1+3=4$ squares right. Vertical shift: $2+1=3$ squares up.

spec.description: Original point and both successive labelled images on the original grid.
Blue triangle on a seven-column, six-row grid.

answer.worked: Move every vertex 3 squares down and join the first image. Move every vertex of that image 2 squares right and join the second image. Each final vertex is 3 squares down and 2 squares right of its original position.

spec.description: Blue original, red first image and green final image.
Blue rectangle whose left side coincides with the grid boundary; its top is one square below the top grid boundary.
spec.mathematics: Source pixels place the rectangle at local x=0 to 2 and y=2 to 5 on a seven-column, six-row grid.

answer.worked: Move the rectangle 3 squares right and 2 squares down. Then move that image 2 squares up. The downward and upward shifts cancel, leaving a translation of 3 squares right.

spec.description: Original rectangle, dashed red first image and solid green final image. Dashing distinguishes overlapping sides.
spec.mathematics: First image spans x=3 to 5,y=0 to 3; final image spans x=3 to 5,y=2 to 5.
spec.answerVisibility: Both requested successive images appear only in answer editions.

children.label: d
children.prompt: Shift 1 right, 3 up, then 2 down, 2 right.

spec.description: Triangle with base on the bottom boundary and apex halfway between vertical grid lines.

answer.worked:
Move each vertex 1 square right and 3 squares up, then move its image 2 squares down and 2 squares right.

Horizontal shift: $1+2=3$ squares right. Vertical shift: $3-2=1$ square up.

spec.description: Original triangle and both successive images, retaining half-square apex positions.
